playwright_race_condition_check: SKIPPED per instructions — the manual smoke test in the request confirmed only 1 /me call (was 2) and the 'Sign-in blocked' card renders on /diagnose#session_id=fake-race-test. Static inspection covers the three fix elements; behavioural check is optional and adds no signal beyond what the code review already gives.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean and minimal: module-level `checkAuthRan` correctly survives StrictMode remounts (module identity is stable inside one browser tab).
Double guard (hash + sessionStorage) is defensive-in-depth: if navigation racily wipes the hash before AuthProvider observes it, the sessionStorage flag still catches it.
AuthCallback keeps the fragment intact until navigate() runs, so App.js's synchronous hash check keeps routing to <AuthCallback/> until the exchange resolves — good.
clearPending() is called on both success and error paths — no stale 'pending' flag can leak into the next login attempt.

Note (non-blocking): the module-level `checkAuthRan` will NOT reset across a full page reload (which is what we want), but IS reset by a hard navigate() from React Router since React Router does not remount the module. This is fine here because AuthProvider re-runs its own /me only through checkAuth() calls the app explicitly triggers (e.g. after logout you'd need to reload or call checkAuth manually). Current app behavior is consistent with intent.
seed_data_creation: Sessions seeded directly into mongodb via _mk_session() helper (TEST_ prefix); auto-cleaned by module fixture.
